definitions.gloss: suppression; subjugation; gaining control by force
definitions.explanation: Using force or authority to bring a situation, area, or group under control. Often used in military, security, and sports contexts.

examples.japanese: {暴動|ぼうどう}を{制圧|せいあつ}する。
{警察|けいさつ}が{現場|げんば}を{制圧|せいあつ}した。
examples.english: The police gained control of the scene.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}チームを{圧倒的|あっとうてき}な{攻撃力|こうげきりょく}で{制圧|せいあつ}した。
examples.english: They dominated the opposing team with overwhelming offensive power.

notes:
A compound of {制|せい} (control/restrain) + {圧|あつ} (pressure). Implies the use of force or overwhelming power to bring something under control.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {制圧|せいあつ}する: to suppress, to subdue
- {武力|ぶりょく}{制圧|せいあつ}: armed suppression
- {制圧|せいあつ}{射撃|しゃげき}: suppressive fire
- {完全|かんぜん}{制圧|せいあつ}: complete subjugation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {鎮圧|ちんあつ}: suppression, quelling — focuses on calming a disturbance
- {制御|せいぎょ}: control — managing or regulating something (less forceful)
- {征服|せいふく}: conquest — complete subjugation of a people or territory
- {弾圧|だんあつ}: oppression — suppressing people or movements through force
